Health/H36.description: Dataset: Health, from the upstream VoT repository. The numeric target column is named OT; the local metadata does not document its unit or exact real-world interpretation, so treat it as an unnamed numeric target. Text facts are aligned to source periods; undated facts are not independently verified as publication-time news.

dataset_info.data_modalities: numeric time series, covariates when supplied, and dated text

forecast_outlook.confidence: Low, medium, or high with a short evidence-based reason.
forecast_outlook.expected_direction: Concise expectation based only on pre-target evidence.
forecast_outlook.horizon: State the horizon and frequency specified by the forecast-task contract.
forecast_outlook.key_signal: Most relevant visible signal, or state evidence is insufficient.
forecast_outlook.uncertainty: Main ambiguity in the supplied history and text.

predictive_factors.covariates: Use supplied covariates only; do not infer unavailable values.
predictive_factors.temporal_patterns: Describe only visible direction, level, turning behavior, and volatility.
predictive_factors.text_evidence: Separate dated text from direct target observations and note relevance limits.
predictive_factors.uncertainty: State unresolved evidence and forecast uncertainty without future claims.
